title: Driving Amazon’s ELECTRIC Delivery Vehicle: Rivian EDV
summary: A first-day ride-along with an Amazon delivery driver using the Rivian electric delivery van. She covers the van's new technology, how it compares to the standard Ford Transit delivery vehicles, and quirks and issues she noticed on the job.
why: HN points to it as a rare review from an actual delivery driver rather than a car reviewer, showing how the van's design suits the job.

quote.text: I started watching it thinking “I’ll only watch a minute or two” and got so engrossed I watched the whole thing.
